title: Skeptical cinematographer Michael convinced by the Mia tests

tellings.quote: generally a skeptic in my life for most things but through seeing this I can't it's hard for me to not believe this stuff

plain: In 2023 in Glendale, California, a cinematographer named Michael watched tests of a child named Mia, who is said to be able to read minds, and says they changed his mind. He worked on the crew of the filmmaker Ky Dickens, whose documentary is about children said to be telepathic. Michael says on the show that he is "generally a skeptic" but after seeing it, "it's hard for me to not believe this stuff," which, if right, would mean the mind reading held up in front of a doubter.
